ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.85:0.15 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (dark charcoal) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central longitudinal dark-intensity band bifurcating the lobes from peduncle to notch. Dark pigmentation borders the entire trailing edge. Scattered, low-density dark mottling blobs localized in the distal region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; calculated internal angle of approximately 52 degrees with a bounding-box depth equivalent to ~12% of the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (1-3 pixel peaks) along the medial trailing edges. Amplitude increases to high-irregularity peaks on the distal 15% of the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal profile; transition from concave curvature at the medial trailing edge to convex sweep at the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized cluster of small, high-contrast dark circular spots on the distal portion of the right lobe, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-parallel diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the right lobe interior surface; minor horizontal linear scratches detected on the medial left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular, ragged margin at the terminal tip of the right lobe suggests previous minor environmental wear or tissue erosion.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark vertical pigmentation line following the central structural divide from the peduncle to the median notch.
